query: INSERT INTO org_inventory_halt (org_id, inventory, marketplace, raised_by, reason, raised_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (org_id, inventory, marketplace) DO UPDATE SET write_only = false, raised_by = EXCLUDED.raised_by, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, raised_at = EXCLUDED.raised_at WHERE org_inventory_halt.write_only
